rules.section: Implementation task sequence and gate design
rules.rule:
After this entire picture is source/contract/model-reviewed and selected through a normal preimplementation publication:

1. Domain/source models, typed generation/JOIN/current-proof ports, migration38 and compiler capability with immutable baseline checks.
2. Complete prepared source hooks across Invite/all four JOIN/retirement, core replay/UNKNOWN proof and same-transaction finite enqueue; test source effects and rollback before target wiring.
3. SocialInbox fixed-source materialize/invalidate commands, terminal witnesses/tombstones, separate Guild ACK and bounded page cursor/reconciliation; test crash/unknown/orphan/races.
4. Same-transaction qualified read/shared observation, exact type10 DTO and full mixed184 preflight/replay; test owner/clock/drain boundaries before HTTP composition.
5. Existing WORLD bridge finite u1 codec/consumer and post-commit first-only emitter; combined API/worker explicit deploy/readiness with old catalog fallback and strict stored-job handling.
6. Freeze a new clean combined candidate, use the exact supplied pinned toolbox for all new native/process/recovery rows and all applicable8A regression requirements, reconcile, verify cumulative checkpoint and explicit parent8 reality/contract registry/normal publication closure.

The candidate gate must include real concurrent and rollback source tests for all four JOIN producers, exact-expiry/cursor exhaustion/pre8 compatibility, target replay/dismissal/deletion/orphan proof, bounded large retirement fanout, creation/cleanup races, target commit-before-sourceACK SIGKILL recovery, positive/absent UNKNOWN, missing job recovery, stale/future clock and rollback cursor holes,128/4096/50 invalid-newer refill,176 replay/no drain on Guild failure, mixed184 single Grant and whole-batch corruption rollback, real HTTP2563/2564/184/176/189 and stock type140 current WORLD path, forged/stale u1 while old r1/g1 remain unchanged, listener/process restart, owner refusal/loss/drain, exact readiness/old pointer preservation/explicit deploy, populated37→38 and complete joint restore/second restart. Existing8A code/source/mail/process behavior must be requalified on the new combined candidate. Final parent8 review separately checks C01-C14,22 immutable foundations, all existing4/5/6/7/8A successor obligations and every new8B contract, without claiming I7A10/E/physical W2 or original-server semantics.

These seams are resolved in the primary design review below; required native proof remains deferred to the new exact combined candidate.
